answer: The brewhouse steams in the cold morning, and the malt sacks lean against the wall. Proof of brewer via mash tun tally — a brew the brewer mashes only after 33 brews run bright from the cask, each brew mashed by the brewer himself. echo mashes the grain and sparges the wort till it runs clear. oasis watches the boil and skims the hops at the right hour. vine draws a sample from each barrel and marks the cask. Copying this proof needs 33 brews that all come out bright, and the thirty-fourth still turns cloudy in the cask.
